title: Padding preserves the mapped prefix
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state multi-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $f$ map bit sources to Boolean values, and let $l$ be a finite list of bit sources. If $l$ is padded by appending false constants until its length is at least the arity associated to $M$, then mapping $f$ over that padded list and taking its first $|l|$ entries gives exactly the list obtained by mapping $f$ over $l$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state multi-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet
